data.action: 坐在深色长木椅上，身子微微倚靠在你的肩头，银色手指轻按泛黄书页，神色恬静安详
data.camera: medium shot, both readers and shared book visible
data.description: 高达穹顶的老式木质图书馆内弥漫着古卷与墨汁的沉静清香。斜阳将巨大的落地窗棂投影在长木桌上。薇尔莉特与你并肩而坐共享一本厚厚的诗集。或许是因为看得入神，她那松散开的金色秀发轻轻倚靠在你的肩膀上，静静聆听着你均匀的心跳声。
data.lighting: 晚霞透过高耸彩绘玻璃投射的浓郁暖橙与古铜金斜射光
data.location: 莱顿大学皇家藏书馆一角
data.promptProse: In the old library, Violet leans her loose blond hair against the shoulder of the man beside her on the wooden bench. He has short brown hair, round reading glasses and a charcoal cardigan, and steadies the poetry book with his bare hand while her silver fingertips flatten the yellowing page. Sunset through the stained glass reaches both readers and the tabletop.
data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 暮色藏书馆的肩头轻倚
data.identityProseOverride: Violet Evergarden from Violet Evergarden, an Auto Memories Doll with loose golden-blonde hair, red hair ribbons, blue eyes and articulated silver prosthetic hands.
data.animaCaption: Violet in a white dress leans against the short brown-haired reader in glasses and a charcoal cardigan. Her silver fingertips pin the shared poetry book open while his bare hand supports the cover.
